text:
Jess: Quick idea — our rollout dashboard is missing a good UX for multi-variant A/B + guard rules. Right now it's just canary vs baseline averages. We should add a ‘guards’ panel with min-sample, effect-size, and consecutive-bucket checks.
Alex: +1. For product, we need to decide how to surface significance. p-values are confusing; show absolute delta + confidence interval and a simple traffic-impact estimate.
Samir: My vote: pragmatic stats (bootstrap CI or Bayesian credible intervals). Also add an alert throttling policy to avoid noise during low-sample windows.
Lee: From runtime side we can emit per-route p50/p90, error-rate, token-count diffs, and sample counts per minute. Suggest effect_size = (canary_median - baseline_median)/baseline_median. Can compute on sliding 5m window.
Maria: Telemetry note: every metric should carry sample_count and variance so downstream can compute CI. Also we should record slice keys (region, customer_tier, model_version) for drilldowns.
Jess: crude alert rule sketch:
```yaml
alert: canary_effect_size
metric: latency_p50
effect_size_threshold: 0.2
min_sample: 500
consecutive_buckets: 3
action: notify:#canary-alerts
auto_rollback: false
```
Samir: +1 but auto_rollback must default to false. We can offer opt-in automation but it should be gated: require at least two metrics (>min_sample) and manual approval for major rollouts.
Alex: UX ask: show "predicted user impact" — estimate % of requests/users that would see regression if we roll forward. Also show top regressed slices and quick links to open an inc/rollback.
Lee: We can generate a "predicted impact" card by replaying 1 minute of traffic distribution across the variants and applying the measured delta. Cheap to run.
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: canary v2.4 -> 10% traffic at 1799990020 (hash: abc123) :rocket:
Maria: I'll extend the TSDB schema to include variance and slice tags then open a PR for the telemetry ingestion.
Jess: Sounds good. I'll draft a proposal doc with mockups and the suggested guard semantics and schedule a 30m sync. @Alex @Samir any blockers on the ideas above? :eyes:
Alex: No blockers from product. Will prep mockups for the guard panel.
Samir: SRE OK, want a follow-up to define alert routing (pager vs slack) and playbook steps for rollback.
Lee: Runtime is fine but we need to ensure we don't increase metrics cardinality too much — prefer a configurable set of slice tags.
Jess: Great — filing the RFC now and assigning owners. Thanks all!
